components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Flag orange on black — Run / Download.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #FF3B0A; color: #fff; border: 1.5px solid #000; border-radius: 1px; padding: 9px 10px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #FF4D1A; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #000; }

components.name: Success Button
components.css: .ds-btn-success { background: #0EA768; color: #fff; border: 1.5px solid #000; border-radius: 1px; padding: 9px 10px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: #fff; color: #0A0A0D; border: 1px solid #1A1D20; border-radius: 1px; padding: 9px 10px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: White window field with orange focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #fff; color: #0A0A0D; border: 1.5px solid #1A1D20; border-radius: 1px; padding: 9px 10px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #FF3B0A; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,59,10,0.28); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6B6760; }

components.name: Running Badge
components.css: .ds-badge-running { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 3px 6px; background: #FF3B0A; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #000; border-radius: 1px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Completed Badge
components.css: .ds-badge-completed { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 3px 6px; background: #0EA768; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #000; border-radius: 1px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Window Card
components.html:
MEDIA FOLDERS
Content in window
components.css: .ds-window { background: #F5F1EB; border: 1px solid #1A1D20; border-radius: 1px; padding: 12px; position: relative; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #000; } .ds-window::before, .ds-window::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 6px; width: 7px; height: 7px; background: #0A0A0D; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-window::before { left: 6px; } .ds-window::after { right: 6px; } .ds-window-title { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; border-bottom: 1px solid #E0D8CC; padding-bottom: 8px; margin-bottom: 12px; }

components.name: Folder Frame
components.css: .ds-folder { min-height: 78px; background: #F5F1EB; border: 1px solid #1A1D20; border-radius: 1px; padding: 10px 9px; text-align: left; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-folder.active { background: #fff; border-color: #000; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #000, 0 2px 0 #000; }

components.name: Stat Flag
components.css: .ds-stat { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #D8D0C2; border-radius: 1px; padding: 10px 8px; position: relative; } .ds-stat::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; height: 3px; background: #FF3B0A; } .ds-stat strong { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-stat span { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 9.5px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6B6760; }

components.name: Progress
components.css: .ds-progress { height: 10px; background: #0A0A0D; border: 1px solid #000; border-radius: 1px; } .ds-progress-bar { height: 100%; background: #FF3B0A; border-right: 1px solid #fff; }

narrative.northStar: The Cutting Bench Select Rail — now site-matched by default
narrative.overview: Batch deck — site-matched VideoExpress violet #7C3AED on light #F3F4F6/#FFFFFF by default; bench red #FF3B0A on #0A0A0D retained as opt-in, plus teal and amber dark variants via header picker (Barlow Condensed 11px). Rail is 44px perforated, windows punched with 7px rivets.
keyCharacteristics: Select rail as queue — position is physical, status is a mark not a hue.
Drenched accent — orange holds 33% via header + rail + progress + flags.
One ink, one flag, one window — #0A0A0D / #FF3B0A / #F5F1EB.
Perforated topology — rail fixed 44px, sections string along it; deferred hangs on pins.
Condensed grotesk caps + mono data — rank by count, hairline ticks.

rules.name: The One Third Rule
rules.body: Flag orange holds 33% — header + rail + progress + 3px stat flags. If heavier, remove orange.

rules.name: The Mark Not Hue Rule
rules.body: Status is a physical mark, not a new hue: grease cross, punched corner, tape band, folded flag, pin.

rules.name: The One Size Rule
rules.body: One size of condensed grotesk does labeling; rank is cell count not type size.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: No soft blur beyond single panel throw. Elevation is hard edge; glow is decoration.

dos: Do keep orange at 1/3 — header + rail + progress + flag.
Do use punched windows with rivets for every section.
Do keep caps and hairlines — Barlow caps, 1.5px #000 on orange, 1px #1A1D20 on white.
Do express state as a mark in the 7px box.
Do preserve sprocket row at top:4px.
donts: Don't revive the light Control Deck — #f7f9fc/#22a7f0 soft blur is anti-reference.
Don't add gradients, glass, or 999px pills.
Don't add a new hue alongside orange.
Don't use Inter, Space Grotesk, IBM Plex, DM Sans as display.
Don't place body below 11px or above 13px inside windows.
